Embedding request via Ollama local provider with all-minilm model

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_embed_async(client, "{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog\",\"model\":\"ollama/all-minilm\"}")
IO.inspect(result.data)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.data, 0).embedding)
```
